testCases.input: What are my main strengths for this AI Engineer role based on my CV?
testCases.actualOutput:
You have experience designing and implementing AI agents using LLMs, including fine-tuning for domain-specific tasks, building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to improve accuracy and reliability, and optimizing inference performance. You also have skills in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and programming languages such as Python.

You have hands-on experience with AI tools like LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, Ollama, and web/deployment frameworks like Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Docker, and Nginx. Additionally, you have worked on designing course content, coding exercises, and mentoring students in career development as a practical training instructor.

Your experience with cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure) and DevOps tools (CI/CD - GitHub Actions) is also relevant to the role.
testCases.expectedOutput: Your main strengths for this AI Engineer role are exceptionally strong and directly aligned with what they're looking for. Your hands-on experience is a huge asset; your internship at Singularity involved designing and implementing the exact kind of AI agents and RAG systems mentioned in the job description. Furthermore, your personal projects, like the 'AI Career Mentor' and 'AR-EN Sales Agent,' demonstrate a complete end-to-end skill set, from development with FastAPI and LangChain to deployment on Azure using Docker and CI/CD, which perfectly matches their need for someone who can build, deploy, and maintain AI applications.

About the job
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-driven solutions that enhance our products and services. You will be responsible for building machine learning models, developing AI algorithms, and integrating AI capabilities into our existing systems. As an AI Engineer, you will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to create intelligent, scalable, and high-performance AI applications.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and implement AI models, machine learning algorithms, and deep learning solutions.
• Train and fine-tune machine learning models using large datasets to improve accuracy and performance.
• Build and optimize AI-driven applications, including natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics.
• Develop and integrate AI models into cloud-based and edge computing environments.

AMIT Learning, Remote

testCases.input: How well does my project experience, especially the AI Career Mentor, align with the key responsibilities of this job?
testCases.actualOutput:
Your experience as an AI Instructor at NTI and AMIT Learning shows alignment with the key responsibility of "Delivering hands-on training in Python, ML, and real-world projects" mentioned in the Job Description. However, your project experience is more focused on teaching and mentoring rather than designing, developing, and implementing AI models.

Your work as an AI Engineer Intern at Singularity involved designing and implementing AI agents using LLMs, which aligns with the key responsibility of "Design, develop, and implement AI models, machine learning algorithms, and deep learning solutions." 

You also have experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which is mentioned in the Job Description as a requirement for building and optimizing AI-driven applications.
testCases.expectedOutput: Your project experience, particularly the AI Career Mentor, aligns remarkably well with the job's key responsibilities. The JD asks for someone to 'design, develop, and implement AI models' and 'deploy AI models to production environments.' Your project shows you've done exactly that by building an end-to-end RAG application. You've handled everything from vector search engineering with pgvector to deployment and monitoring with Docker, Azure, and Grafana. This is a powerful, practical example of you performing the core duties of the role.
